{{Quote|He can't! Raise the shields!"<br />"We cannot. The shields are still recharging.|Trench and TI-99, during the Battle of Christophsis|<ref name="CAM" />}}
'''TI-99''' was a [[T-series tactical droid/Legends|T-series tactical droid]] who served [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Trench/Legends|Trench]] aboard the [[Providence-class carrier/destroyer/Legends|Separatist dreadnaught]] [[Invincible/Legends|''Invincible'']] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], he was destroyed in orbit of [[Christophsis/Legends|Christophsis]] during the planet's [[Battle of Christophsis/Legends|blockade]] by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], after [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] redirected the flagship's own torpedoes into the CIS ship's [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|command bridge]].<ref name="CAM" />

{{Droid-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
TI-99 was voiced by [[Phil LaMarr]], who also provided the voices of [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]], the senators [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Prestor Organa]], [[Orn Free Taa/Legends|Orn Free Taa]] and another [[Unidentified T-series tactical droid (Nuvo Vindi)|T-series tactical droid]] in the series.
